description: Final release-governance output produced by C4 after candidate retraining, pre-release validation, future-safety forecasting, joint conformal calibration, risk-policy evaluation, and deterministic hard-gate authorization.

decision.description: Final deterministic release decision produced by C4.

decision_rules.AUTO_DEPLOY: All mandatory hard gates pass and the conservative lower bounds of all mandatory future-safety intervals satisfy the calibrated release requirements.
decision_rules.HUMAN_REVIEW: All mandatory hard gates pass, but at least one uncertainty interval crosses a required safety boundary.
decision_rules.ESCALATE: A mandatory hard gate fails, or at least one complete future-safety interval lies below a mandatory safety boundary. Also triggered if C2 diagnosis_stability < 0.5.

champion_model_id.description: Identifier of the current production champion model. Must match C1 model_id.

candidate_model_id.description: Identifier of the repaired and retrained candidate model evaluated by C4.

joint_confidence_level.description: Target simultaneous conformal coverage level for mandatory future-safety margins.

future_safety_margins.description: Forecasted signed future-safety margins. Values >= 0 indicate safety requirement satisfied. Negative values indicate violation.

global_margin.description: Forecasted future global candidate-versus-champion safety margin.

affected_slice_margin.description: Forecasted future affected-slice recovery margin. Slice defined by C2 affected_slice_rule.

future_safety_intervals.description: Joint conformal uncertainty intervals for the three mandatory future-safety margins at joint_confidence_level coverage.

global_margin.description: Lower and upper conformal bounds for global safety margin.

affected_slice_margin.description: Lower and upper conformal bounds for affected-slice recovery margin.

non_affected_margin.description: Lower and upper conformal bounds for non-affected safety margin.

pre_release_evidence.description: C4-generated validation evidence measured before the release decision.

validation_global_f1_gain.description: Observed candidate-versus-champion global F1 difference on release-validation data.

validation_affected_slice_recovery.description: Observed affected-slice recovery on release-validation data.

upstream_evidence_summary.description: Summary of all C1, C2, and C3 evidence consumed by C4.

hard_gate_status.description: Deterministic mandatory release gates. All must PASS before AUTO_DEPLOY is possible.

repair_approved.description: True if C3 repair_package_status is APPROVED

schema_compatible.description: Candidate model input schema matches production schema

candidate_artifact_valid.description: Candidate model artifact is loadable and produces valid outputs

rollback_ready.description: Champion model rollback artifact is available if deployment fails

overall.description: PASS only if all individual gates are PASS. Any FAIL triggers ESCALATE.

risk_control.description: Calibrated release-policy information used by the C4 release controller.

risk_control_target.description: Configured unsafe automatic-release risk target used during policy calibration.

risk_context.description: Evidence-risk context used by the evidence-adaptive release-policy extension.

policy_parameter.description: Calibrated release-policy parameter for the current risk context.

reason.example: The affected-slice uncertainty interval crosses the required future safety boundary, so automatic deployment cannot be justified.
reason.description: Human-readable rationale based only on measured evidence, calibrated intervals, hard gates, and the approved release policy.

required_action.example: Human review before controlled staging deployment.
required_action.description: Operational action required after the C4 decision.

audit_id.description: Unique identifier for the complete release-decision audit record.

policy_version.description: Version of the calibrated deterministic release policy used for the decision.

forecast_model_version.description: Version of the Quantile LightGBM future-safety forecasting model.

conformal_config_version.description: Version of the joint conformal calibration configuration.

mlflow_run_id.description: MLflow run ID linking the decision to the candidate model experiment.

decision_timestamp.description: Timestamp at which the final C4 release decision was recorded.

auto_deploy.reason: All mandatory hard gates pass and the conservative lower bounds of all future-safety intervals satisfy the calibrated release requirements.

human_review.reason: The affected-slice uncertainty interval crosses the required future safety boundary, so automatic deployment cannot be justified.
human_review.required_action: Human review before controlled staging deployment.

escalate.reason: The complete global and affected-slice uncertainty intervals lie below their mandatory safety boundaries, indicating the candidate is confidently predicted to violate critical release requirements.
escalate.required_action: Escalate for further repair or engineering investigation. Do not deploy the candidate.

notes: Future safety margins are signed values and are NOT restricted to 0.0-1.0 range
A future safety margin >= 0 indicates satisfaction of its corresponding future requirement
AUTO_DEPLOY requires all hard gates PASS and all lower interval bounds satisfy calibrated release requirements
HUMAN_REVIEW is deliberate abstention when uncertainty crosses one or more release boundaries
ESCALATE when hard gate FAIL, or complete safety interval below boundary, or diagnosis_stability < 0.5
upstream_evidence_summary.c2.affected_features_ranked matches C2 output field name affected_features_ranked
C4 does not use a hand-weighted composite risk score as its primary decision mechanism
Evidence-adaptive risk context and policy parameters must be calibrated using development data only
AUTO_DEPLOY authorizes controlled staging rollout, not direct production replacement
Every decision must be traceable to champion model, candidate model, all upstream evidence, and policy version
